name: smart-lift-management-system
description: A comprehensive, responsive Building Lift Management System built for **DANFEZ TECH HOUSE**. The system features a mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA) architecture with an interactive 10-floor virtual elevator simulation, real-time telemetry, multi-user authentication, maintenance work order workflows, safety fault triage, certified technician management, analytics dashboards, and role-based access control.
